offersHint: Gency AI product image generation - MCP server for Claude, Codex, Cursor, VS Code · Packages: npm:@gency-ai/gency-mcp · Env vars: GENCY_API_URL, GENCY_MCP_ALLOWED_CLIENT_IDS, GENCY_MCP_OAUTH_RESOURCE, GENCY_MCP_UPLOAD_SECRET, GENCY_OAUTH_API_BASE, GENCY_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID, GENCY_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET, GENCY_OAUTH_SCOPE

environmentVariables.name: GENCY_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Gency API base URL

environmentVariables.name: GENCY_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client ID override. Defaults to the built-in official client, so most users never set this.

environmentVariables.name: GENCY_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client secret, only needed for confidential clients.

environmentVariables.name: GENCY_OAUTH_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: OAuth provider base URL. Defaults to GENCY_API_URL.

environmentVariables.name: GENCY_OAUTH_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Space-separated OAuth scopes.

environmentVariables.name: GENCY_MCP_ALLOWED_CLIENT_IDS
environmentVariables.description: serve-http only: OAuth client IDs whose tokens this server accepts (space or comma separated). Empty accepts any client.

environmentVariables.name: GENCY_MCP_UPLOAD_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: serve-http only: HMAC key for signed upload handles. Only needed when running more than one instance, so a handle issued by one verifies on another.

environmentVariables.name: GENCY_MCP_OAUTH_RESOURCE
environmentVariables.description: RFC 8707 resource indicator to send on authorize/token/refresh requests. Opt-in until the Gency authorization server is confirmed to accept it.
